text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH metering-service token-count drift detected in eu-west-1. Alert id: PGR-3421. Symptoms: sustained +20% delta vs baseline over last 10m. Checking shards...
jordan: ack — I'm on it.
maria: looking at the billing pipeline, we have a consumer lag spike then a small replay burst. Duplicates showing up in the tally stream. Early count: ~120 customers may have transient overage flags.
lee: any obvious replay loop or partition hotness? which consumer group?
maria: consumer group: billing-ingest-prod, partition 23 shows replay pattern. Logs:
```
[kafka-consumer] partition=23 offset_replay detected last_offset=1245512 previous=1245489 replay_count=1
[kafka-consumer] lag=+3215 msgs, rate spike at 2024-03-12T22:34:10Z
```
sarah: CS: we already received 2 inbound tickets where customers said they got an "unexpected usage" email. Need to suspend outbound overage emails asap. Drafting customer-facing blurb.
jordan: pausing automated overage emails via feature toggle: /run toggle billing_alerts=false --env prod
deploy-bot: Config change queued by jordan. Rolling out toggle to 4 regions.
pat: I'll isolate the consumer, prevent further replays and checkpoint. Planning manual offset reset for partition 23.
maria: initiating manual reset: `kafka-reset-offset --topic usage-events --partition 23 --to-offset 1245520`
lee: good — lag dropped after reset, but backlog replays will still emit historical tokens into the tally. We should enable dedupe in the tally layer to avoid double-counting.
jordan: quick mitigation: enable dedupe-by-request_id gate with TTL=24h on tally. This is low-risk.
maria: deploying hotfix: billing-dedupe v0.1-hotfix -> /deploy billing-dedupe:v0.1-hotfix (rolling)
sarah: CS: hold on external comms until we confirm how many customers were impacted and whether charges appear on invoices. Draft saved.
pat: rough timeline: backfill and reconciliation work will take ~2-3 hours. We'll produce corrected usage deltas and suppress interim alerts.
lee: handoff to night oncall @taylor for the post-replay reconciliation and customer follow-ups. Please confirm ownership.
taylor: saw thread — I'll take this. I'll run the backfill job, verify dedupe effectiveness, and coordinate final customer messaging. ETA ~3h, will update here.
sarah: thanks @taylor. CS will queue the customer note once you confirm final counts.
pat: adding runbook link to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering/dedupe-backfill :wave:
jordan: quick note — saved snapshots of pre/post counts to s3://redwood-debug/metering/pgr-3421 for audit.
incident-bot: Incident PGR-3421 acknowledged and assigned to night-oncall. Severity: P2 — customer emails sent (paused), reconciliation in progress.
